topic.title: Oxygen Emmet Plugin Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Oxygen Emmet Plugin add-on provides high-speed coding and editing by expanding abbreviations into code snippets in supported document types.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen XML Developer
Oxygen JSON Editor
body.p: The Oxygen Emmet Plugin add-on provides the means for high-speed coding and editing in Text mode or Author mode via a content assistance mechanism. It can be used for HTML, XSL, CSS, LESS, and other formats. For example, with the Emmet add-on installed, you can type abbreviations (similar to CSS selectors) and expand them into full-fledged HTML code. The add-on contributes a submenu named Emmet in the contextual menu and it contains actions for expanding abbreviations or wrapping content with an expanded abbreviation. The two actions can also be invoked using the Alt + Shift + E (Ctrl + Shift + E on macOS) or Alt + Shift + W (Ctrl + Shift + W on macOS) keyboard shortcuts.
